address: Sheridan Rd & Foster Ave, Chicago, IL 60640
recipient: Mrs. Anna Robinson, Oak Grove, Mo.
notes: The Sands Motel, Chicago — AAA-rated, 150 air-conditioned rooms with 21-inch television, adjoining the Edgewater Beach Hotel, Sheridan Rd & Foster Ave. Front shows an aerial view of the motel's pool/parking court with the Edgewater Beach Hotel towers behind it and a 'Peter Pan' snack shop sign in the foreground. Three 1¢ Washington (Liberty series) stamps; Chicago postmark JUL 20 1959, plus a transit backstamp from Berrien Springs, Mich. Message describes a whirlwind day of Chicago sightseeing: church, Chinatown, Maxwell Street Market, Hull House, the Palmer House, the Drake Hotel, the Museum of Science and Industry, the Art Institute, then swimming in Lake Michigan — with a plan to spend the next day at Arlington Park race track.
recipientLocationNote: There's more than one 'Oak Grove' in Missouri — pinned the better-known one near Kansas City (Jackson/Lafayette Co.); flag if you know it's the other.

location: American Southwest — Joshua Trees (Petley Studios, Phoenix, AZ)
recipient: Irene D. Morris, 1441 Wendy St. N.W., Apt. 94, Canton, Ohio 44709
notes: Joshua Trees card by Petley Studios, 4051 E. Van Buren, Phoenix, AZ 85008 — card #KV9641. Back copy explains the Joshua tree's Mormon-pioneer naming legend ('praying plant,' up-stretched arms). Since the publisher is Phoenix-based, this may depict Arizona high desert rather than California's Joshua Tree National Park specifically — pinned generally pending confirmation. USA 15¢ flag stamp ('The Land of the Free, The Home of the Brave'), consistent with the 1978–1981 window; meter slogan cancel for Muscular Dystrophy support. Message (partial, cursive faint): 'Hello Irene! Having a wonderful time... trying to see it all... the weather is great... We stopped 3 nights at ___... Write me a line...' POSSIBLE FAMILY NETWORK NODE: recipient 'Irene D. Morris' likely matches the 'Irene Morris' addressed as a girl on the 1956 Fontana Dam card (#170), then in Alliance, Ohio — about 20 miles from this Canton, Ohio address.
